summary: Batch-3 e2e: 22/22 backend pytest passed (breach, recovery-odds, phishing Claude Sonnet 4.5, account-worth, selfie-coach, public+admin announcements, tool_meta mongo side-effect, regression of /api/tools/appeal, /api/tools/faq, /api/config, /api/chat/message). Frontend Playwright verified: /tools hub renders all 9 tiles (single-column at x=16 on 375x800 mobile), breach scan for test@example.com → 201 breaches + critical risk + safety-card-warn rendered, recovery-odds shows 86% / 95% on defaults, phishing flagged scammy bit.ly DM as CRITICAL · DO NOT ENGAGE, account-worth shows INR & USD toggle + Share button, selfie-coach scores 100/READY on perfect defaults. Admin /admin → BROADCAST → NEW ANNOUNCEMENT modal → BLAST IT created an announcement, list shows TG 0/0 · EMAIL 0/0 · SENT with success toast 'Announcement sent · TG 0 · Email 0'. All test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: Resend email blast IS live and reaches real seeded users (1st batch3 run with send_email=true delivered to 6 users + 8 failures). Not a bug, but worth fronting an admin 'preview audience size + confirm' guard before BLAST IT, especially with audience=all. Currently the BLAST is irreversible.
Audience 'paying' uses statuses ['paid','completed','delivered'] — if any other paid-state strings are introduced later this will silently drop them.

ui_bugs.issue: Result panel renders correctly but lacks data-testid='phishing-result' / 'risk-badge' as advertised in the review spec — tests have to fall back to text content. Add testids for stability.
FAB buttons do not carry data-testid attributes (e.g. fab-telegram/fab-email/fab-faq). Tests had to detect them by position only.

Floating action stack overlaps the bottom-right corner of the Breach Checker tile on 375x800 (FAB y≈730 vs tile spans y=646..880). Not blocking interaction (tile body is full-width), but visually crowded — consider raising the FABs' bottom offset on mobile.

action_items: (low) Add data-testid='phishing-result' on the result panel inside PhishingDetector.jsx and data-testid='fab-{telegram,email,faq}' on the three FloatingStack buttons.

(low) Add a 'audience size preview + confirm' modal before /admin/announcements blast — currently a single click sends real emails to every opted-in seed user (Resend blast went out to 6 users during this iteration).
(very low) Consider raising bottom offset of FloatingStack on viewport <420px so the FABs don't visually overlap the 2nd tool tile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3370 lines — even further past the 700-line guideline (was 2917 in iter-2). Splitting tools/* + admin/announcements into modules is overdue.

/api/admin/announcements does the blast SYNCHRONOUSLY inside the request handler (Telegram loop with 50ms sleep per user + Resend loop). For audience=all on real growth it will block the request for tens of seconds. Move to a background task (asyncio.create_task or BackgroundTasks) and update tg_sent/email_sent counters out-of-band.

Both the announcement Telegram blast AND email blast iterate db.users with an audience_filter — if audience='all' and a user has NO email AND NO telegram_chat_id they're correctly skipped, but the audience_filter for telegram is built before the existence check; this is fine but duplicated logic could be factored.
Duplicate LLM bootstrap code still present across /api/tools/appeal, /api/tools/faq, /api/tools/phishing-check (flagged in iter-2, still not refactored).
/api/tools/breach forwards the email to XposedOrNot but does NOT URL-escape the path/params separately — httpx params= handles this safely, so OK; just worth a comment to prevent regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows: hub-desktop, hub-mobile-single-col, breach, odds, phishing, worth INR/USD, selfie, admin broadcast end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral announcements created during testing (TEST Announcement 7e888f and TEST Announcement UI) — both deleted via DELETE /api/admin/announcements/{id}. tool_meta.is_new=true was set for tool_id='breach' as a side-effect of the test_tool_meta_marked_new test; cleanup of tool_meta was NOT performed (it only affects whether the Breach tile shows a NEW badge on the hub).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_batch3_tools.py -v`. The admin announcement blast test uses send_telegram=False & send_email=False to avoid spamming real Resend recipients (the seed has ~14 real-looking emails). The phishing endpoint is a real LLM call (~8-12s); already returned high/critical on a bit.ly Instagram-impersonation DM. Public /api/announcements is paginated to latest 10. tool_meta collection now has is_new=true for 'breach' from the persistence test — main agent should reset that when the breach tile is no longer 'new'. NOTE: an earlier UI run sent live emails to 6 real users via Resend before I gated the test — see backend_issues.minor for the audience-confirm recommendation.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All 5 new tools + the announcement system work end-to-end. Findings are quality-of-life: synchronous blast handler, missing testids, mobile FAB overlap, and a recommended audience-size confirm guard before BLAST IT to prevent accidental mass email.
